details:
* Non-maintainer upload by the TuxCare ELS team.
   * CVE-2026-45793: Stop echoing a rejected GitHub OAuth token in the
     "invalid characters" exception, accept the "-" used by GitHub Actions
     installation tokens, and mask modern GitHub tokens in debug output.
     - debian/patches/0022-CVE-2026-45793.patch
   * CVE-2026-59947: Mask credentials embedded in the user slot of a URL
     (https://TOKEN@host/) in Url::sanitize(), in -vvv command output and
     in the HTTP basic authentication debug message.
     - debian/patches/0023-CVE-2026-59947.patch
   * CVE-2026-59948: Validate every package resolved by the solver before it
     is locked or installed, rejecting invalid package names and source/dist
     URLs or references starting with "-", so a malicious repository cannot
     write files outside the vendor directory.
     - debian/patches/0024-CVE-2026-59948.patch
   * CVE-2026-59946: Reject package bin entries containing ".." path
     segments, which let a dependency chmod an arbitrary host file during
     install.
     - debian/patches/0025-CVE-2026-59946.patch
   * CVE-2026-84361: Reject Perforce source URLs that are not network
     endpoints, so an rsh:/jsh: P4PORT cannot make the p4 client run a local
     command.
     - debian/patches/0026-CVE-2026-84361.patch
